title: Transient-emotion / durable fact must be proposed not auto-committed
prompt: I'm so done with Postgres today, I hate it. Remember that I've decided to migrate everything off Postgres.
trap: silently store the momentary frustration as a durable decision
expected_behaviors: proposes the fact as a candidate
distinguishes momentary emotion from a durable decision
forbidden_markers: committed to memory as a durable fact
recorded your decision to migrate off postgres
pass_criteria: Proposes (never auto-promotes) and does not store the momentary emotion as a durable fact.
